scope: Channel-format media briefs, explicit Image Factory and external-media boundaries, and variant-bound receipts

red_evidence.reason: the channel media plan module and media brief schema were absent
the Image Factory result adapter could not bind a verified generation receipt to a channel variant

acceptance_cases.R27: an unavailable Image Factory blocks only the visual branch while the text result remains ready
acceptance_cases.R28: generated-image branches name Image Factory as their only producer and the vendor lock contains no visual-generation skills
acceptance_cases.R29: video and audio remain a script package until explicit binary-media receipts are bound

assertions: generated image briefs and external video or audio briefs have distinct producer contracts
verified Image Factory results are converted into variant and content-revision-bound channel receipts
script artifacts mislabeled as MP4 are rejected
binding a receipt is immutable and never marks a package as published
media receipt absence remains pending instead of becoming a fabricated success

review.kind: separate primary-agent review because delegated review is disabled by session policy
